project_type: Single-page HTML app with Vercel serverless API functions
build_system: Vercel (no build step, echo done). Uses CDN Tailwind CSS.
test_framework: None - no test files exist. Validation is manual/visual.
test_command: node -c index.html is not applicable. Use: node --check api/analyze.js to validate JS syntax.
verification_instructions: 1. Run node --check on all api/*.js files to verify syntax. 2. Open index.html in browser to verify UI changes. 3. Validate HTML is well-formed.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode - can install npm packages. No Docker daemon available. Vercel CLI not available for local dev server. Validation is syntax-based.
contribution_requirements: Keep api/*.js file count at 12 or fewer (currently 10). Work on feat/ai-chart-reader-app branch only. Do not push broken code. Keep app smooth and anti-lag.
key_patterns: Single index.html contains all HTML + CSS + JS. API endpoints in api/*.js as CommonJS modules. Tailwind CSS via CDN with dark theme (bg-[#0b0e14], bg-[#151a23], emerald accents). Session-based chat history in localStorage under key autocuan_chat_sessions. Uses Gemini 2.5 Flash for AI. Three analysis modes: ticker (ticker+price), chart_upload (image), chat_mode (conversation).
directory_structure: / - root with index.html (1631 lines, single-page app), /api - 10 serverless functions, /assets - IDX ticker data
